name: Needing God
overview: Scripture reveals our deep need for God’s guidance, provision, and grace. Believers are called to trust wholeheartedly in the LORD rather than their own understanding, resting in His faithfulness to sustain and care for them as they do good (Psalms 37:3; Proverbs 3:5; Psalms 55:22). Salvation itself is a gift from God, received by grace through faith, underscoring our complete dependence on Him (Ephesians 2:8). This reliance on God also shapes our relationships, prompting kindness and forgiveness modeled on the forgiveness we have received through Christ (Ephesians 4:32), and leads us to continual rejoicing in the Lord (Philippians 4:4).
